Her next lead is an "Eye of Argonia" for sale in Gideon's market. It is probably glass, so I'm to find out where it came from. I would get there by rootworm from Helstrom, which Cheeval-Xu calls.

I never asked Nesh-Deeka about the Root, the Xeech-Leel or Umbriel, so I still don't know what those are. I also don't know what guards the Root or what the seal is made of.
